text: Skiapena is a young Sabbat Lasombra mentored by Cardinal Mysancta.

The Soul Golems, also known as Somnia Draconis, were guardians and sentinels for the mages of Atlantis. Gifted with sentience and rough magical understandings by the Soulstones that empowered them, the Golems served their creators faithfully and without question. Some used to protect settlements or households, while others worked together with the Ungula Draconis or acted as bodyguards. The materials from which they were formed varied, but all were inscribed with crackling runes of power that animated them in the first place. When the hubris of mages cracked the skies and sundered the cosmos, Atlantis sank into the sea and magic was changed forever. The sentinels watched helplessly as the people and places they had been created to protect were destroyed or killed. Nearly all of the sentinels in Atlantis during the Fall were destroyed by the upheaval, the magic that held their bodies together no match for the forces of destruction unleashed. The very few surviving Soul Golems divided into two camps, those that would actively search its masters, and others that simply resumed their duties. Some of the Somnia Draconis are driven insane by the loss of their soulstones - and therefore their intelligence- and growing abyssal taint within the Fallen World. All surviving Soul Golems are able to take on a human form in order to blend into sleeper society.
Songs of Shadows was a Red Talon Theurge who gave the Ten Visions prophecy during the Dark Ages.

Binky is an American M1A2 Abrams battle tank under the command of General Shepherd and belonging to the U.S. Army Rangers during the events of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2. Binky is only seen in the level Team Player where it assists the Rangers in taking a bridge leading to an Afghan town. It provides direct fire support, and remains on the ridge to the left of the bridge after the player crosses into the town. Binky is never seen again in the game.
Sprints-with-the-Wind is a Metis Ahroun of the Wendigo tribe. Her Metis condition is presumably kyphosis, judging by the art depicting her.
Speaks-of-Fire is a Lupus Philodox Wendigo. He appears in Rage.
:If you are looking for the Hunter: The Vigil SAS, see Spearfinger (book). Spearfinger, also known as Utlunta or Granny Death, is a powerful spirit that prefers to hunt in mountain settings.

The is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It was cut from Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare.
The Spirit-Claimed (First Tongue: Duguthim) are humans who have entirely merged with spirits.
Sparkly is an non-sentient independent glowing ball Chimera.

Sonja is a seventh generation Gangrel and the sire of Kai Walch. She met Kai in the nightlife of Germany and eventually romanced him. After revealing her nature, she embraced Kai and abandoned him right after.
is a weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts.

Sultan Amir Nagda was a Khan Bastet who fought Lord Rackbur in the Nagda-Rackbur War. Taken over by his rage, the Sultan Nagda betrayed his race and used a tribal secret. During an eclipse, his assassins struck all over Asia, slaying nearly 100 Khan and many Kinfolk outright. The Bagheera, outraged, set a huge force against him. It was a bloody battle at the height of monsoon season, but Nagda and his followers were killed.

The Strix, plural Striges, are mysterious owl-like creatures with a special connection to vampires. They date at least back to the time of Rome, where they made a bargain with the Julii, though it is known that the people from the Vinca in the Neolithic Era knew about their existence.
Storm-Born are the weirdness of the Savage West manifests in the Storm-Born, the peculiar half-spirit children of the Storm Umbra.
Blunt Force Personalization Pack is a downloadable content package available for Call of Duty: Ghosts. It contains a weapon camo, reticle, a player background and a player patch.
Stuart Olmo is one of the Lost Boys, a group of humans physically enhanced by the Delta Protocol and now addicted to its Serum.

Swan Maidens are a recently-emerged kith born from dreams of romance and true love. Swan Maidens are native to Italy, France, and parts of Germany, though they can be found world-wide. They are naturally drawn towards places of great beauty. In appearance, swan maidens of all genders tend to be delicate, androgynous, and predisposed to elaborate attire. Their fae mien reveals elegant wings merged with their arms, with feathers of black, white or gray.
Sue was a slave who was killed during an escape attempt. As a wraith, she became an Anacreon for the Legion of Paupers of the Atlanta Necropolis.
Bling Personalization Pack is a downloadable content package available for Call of Duty: Ghosts. It contains a weapon camo, reticle, a player background, and a player patch.
Stoneheart is a Spirit and Familiar that serves a chantry of Euthanatos as their Guardian. But is secretly corrupting them.

Stilgar is an ancient Gangrel of Iceland and the sire of Mirko Mirkonen. Mirko grew up in a small village that was both ruled and protected by the ancient Stilgar. Mirko quickly became Stilgar's favored disciple and earned the Embrace. After years of tutelage under his mentor's guidance, Mirkonen left his village to wander Europe, serving as a mercenary in several conflicts.
Stravinsky is a renowned Tzimisce of unknown generation and former Sabbat Archbishop of Mexico City.
Blinkers are an enemy in the Exo Zombies mode of Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, being featuted on the maps Carrier and Descent.

Stephen Trevaine, also known as Stephen Trevanus, was an early Craftmason who lead a group of outlaws reminiscent of the legend of . His greatest achievement was when he masterminded the Craftmasons' attack on Mistridge in 1210. He is also considered a founder and leader of the High Guild.

Taurobolium is the unique Discipline of the Galloi, a bloodline of the Nosferatu clan of Kindred. The Galloi claim to have originated in the Cult of the goddess Cybele, whose mortal members bathed in the fresh hot blood of a multilated bull during an initiation rite known as the Taurobolium. The vampiric worshippers of Cybele used the blood of mortal humans, and developed the rite into a Discipline allowing them to bathe another in their Vitae, granting the bather blessings from Cybele.

Tariq, commonly known as The Silent, is an Assamite antitribu unaffiliated with the Sabbat and assumed Dominion of the Black Hand. He also occupies a place among the Red List. He was among the Cainites who diablerized the Lasombra Antediluvian.

The Blue Steam Trap is a trap in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare on the Exo Zombies map Carrier. It is located on a flight of stairs, and when activated for 500 credits, either side of the stairwell will have been blocked by this blue steam. While the first one will not always kill zombies, the second one will always finish them off.
Tammy Walenski is a 7th-generation Nosferatu of Chicago who had a bad childhood.

Tamara Tvarivich is the Russian Queen of the House Crescent Moon of Silver Fangs. Because she is a direct descendant of the greatest Russian Silver Fang heroes, it has fallen to Tamara the mantle of leadership of her Russian kin through the difficult time behind Baba Yaga’s Shadow Curtain. She is a master Theurge and fought on the front lines even after her uncle, the house leader, was slain.
Talaq was once an Assamite warrior who has been turned into a mortal again through mysterious means. He was, for a long time, the ruler of Petra.

Below the Belt (referred to as "Below the belt" in-game) is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare exclusive to the RPR Evo - Bosozoku variant. It changes the multipliers of the weapon variant, causing damage multipliers to switch for headshots and the groin. This in turn causes more damage to be dealt near the groin as opposed to towards the head.
Tassia is a Seelie cat Pooka Wilder and ward of Duke Pwyffelt.
Takoda Walking-Bear is a member of Verbena who focuses on healing magic.

Syntyche was a changeling who lived in the third century BC. She was married to an Ephesian innkeeper by the name of Eirenaios, who knew of the entirety of her story. The woman was described as being made of stone.

Berserker is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is the Karma-45 Deimos and the Atlas Annihilators Epic Gun perk. Upon killing an enemy, the weapon's fire rate and recoil are increased and decreased respectively for a short period of time. The VPR - Hades variant formerly had this Gun Perk before it was changed to the Silent Fury which is a similar effect but with the integrated suppressor.
Talks-to-Spirits is a Lupus Theurge Wendigo. She appears in Rage. She follows Natasha Moon Chaser into the Umbra to view the past to find a way to defeat the Storm Eater.

Sylphs are fickle air-spirits known for playing cruel tricks on those they victimize. They are described as having whispers like slicing scissor blades. Sylphs act as ambassadors among air spirits to other elementals, much as salamanders do for fire-spirits, or undines for water-spirits.
Tania Erwin is a wraith worshipped by the Riders of the Wheel.
The Bered MK8 is a magazine-fed light machine gun that appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered. It was added to the game in the June 27th, 2017 update.
Tambertail was a Fianna Theurge who was killed by Black Spiral Dancers and had his heart made into a mummified fetish.
Terdak Lingba is a Metis Theurge Stargazer former Master of the Rite of the Sept of the Snow Leopard.
Terrifisto is a Tzimisce and the Sabbat Archbishop of Detroit.
The is a melee weapon that was added to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered on the June 27th, 2017 update.
The Kid is a wraith character featured in the adventure, "Six-Guns and Soulfire" from the Midnight Express book.
Thunderbird, also called Wakinyan Tanka, is a totem of the Fera.

Thomas Bateman is a former director of Bishopsgate Mental Asylum, whose tenure ran from 1980 to his arrest on murder and embezzlement charges in 1991. Following his death in prison, he became one of the many ghosts haunting Bishopsgate.

The Bofors 40mm is a anti-aircraft/multi-purpose autocannon featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized, Find Makarov: Operation Kingfish, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, Call of Duty: WWII, and Call of Duty: Vanguard.
Thomas Kershaw was a street preforming magician in life. In death, he became a wraith of the Iron Legion who seeks for the position for Anacreon of Atlanta.
Thomas Carlyle is a seventh generation Ventrue and the sire of the powerful Dorian Adams of Washington D.C..
The Usurer is a wraith who works for Ti-Tsang Wang in Feng-tu.

The Blade of Barbarossa is the broken blade of Frederick Barbarossa's Sword that appears in Call of Duty: WWII Nazi Zombies. It was recovered by Raven team of the Monuments, Fine Arts, and Archives Program while they were surviving in Berlin, Nazi Germany after escaping from Heligoland.

Theodore is a Nosferatu knight of the St. Ladre Nosferatu. He supported the escape of the elder Nosferatu Malachite from Constantinople, fighting the Latin enemies and Lasombra along the way, suffering some battle wounds. Later, he joined Malachite's party, taking care of Malachite's childe and scouted for the St. Ladre during the travel to Erciyes.

Thunder Jack was a Qualmi and a friend of Eldridge Bonecrusher. When Bonecrusher's daughter was killed by Garou, he fell into hibernation in Jack's den-realm. Jack not only permitted Bonecrusher to stay there, but created wards to keep out intruders - specifically his daughter, Maggie Two-Woman. He incorporated "Rabbit magic" into the wards, as he knew that Maggie had a particular blind spot when it came to rabbits.
Countess Toireasa is a Seelie Sidhe Wilder of House Fiona in the Kingdom of Willows.
The Blyskawica is a submachine gun that was added to Call of Duty: WWII with the 1.24 patch update on June 4th, 2019.
form and Ling Chu in Homid form]] Tiger Toranaga, also known as Isao Toranaga, is a Japanese Bastet (WTA) of the Khan tribe and member of the Yakuza in that country.
Tony is a vampire from Newark, New Jersey, and the contact of Ludo Giovanni.
Trevero is one of the draconic Zmei from Russia. He can spew a stream of highly toxic green poison from his mouth.
The Bechowiec is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: WWII. It was added via an update on July 23rd, 2019.
Trolls are one of the sub-types of the Ogre seeming. These changelings are manipulative grotesqueries. Theirs is the blessing of Unyielding Voice.
True Thomas, also known as Thomas of Ercildoune or Thomas the Rhymer, is the mortal Grand Bard of the fae.

The Tzimisce Antediluvian, commonly referred to as the Eldest by its descendants, is the most inscrutable of all the Antediluvians, consumed as it is with questions of Metamorphosis and the arcane requirements to advance on this Path. Whatever parts of it that were human, if it were ever human, are long abandoned. The Eldest's sire is often debated. According to the Tzimisce, their progenitor was a childe of Ynosh. According to the Legend of Irad, found in some versions of the Book of Nod, he was a childe of Irad.

The Boat is a vehicle featured on Battle Royale mode in Call of Duty: Mobile. It can be found out in the Isolated ocean near the shore or in the river where it is more common. It can seat 6 players. 1 pilot seat and 5 passenger seats.

The Urge Wyrms are spiritual entities of pure, though corrupted, feelings. They are unable to manifest physically, but can influence those around them. However, without a mind to push their agendas, they are nothing but screaming wisps in the umbral night.

Ulu was a Stargazer who was a companion of the twins Yuri Tvarivich and Sophia Tvarivich in their battle against Zmei Sharkala the Cruel in 1240. He volunteered in Kiev, as soon as he heard the sibilings plight. Ulu and Georges of Armenia were ordered to perform the Song of Deep Sleep so they could make the Zmei sleep in case he could not be defeated. Ulu survived the battle, however, Sharkala prophesied that he would end "cursing at dry parchments in bitter wastes".

]] The Typhonian Beast, Typhonian Animal, or Typhonic Beast was the name given to a creature of powerful malice created by Set by dark magic. The animal's own long-extinct species survives only through its association with the Antediluvian, while its original name is long-forgotten.

Blind Fire is a gameplay feature in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It allows the player to shoot their gun without being able to see. Only certain areas allow the access of Blind Fire such as corner walls and barrels. Objects that are Mountable can also be used to Blind Fire. Like mounting, blind fire allows the unlock of multiple calling cards.

Undines are water-spirits that take the form of women. Those whom they choose as their victims, they grab and take under the water to drown. Much as salamanders and erdgeister, undines act as ambassadors for spirits of their element.
Utluhtu (aka Spearfinger) is a "Creature of Native American Myths." She is a malevolent spirit.

Velya, The Vivisectionist, is a 5th generation elder of the Sabbat and a Tzimisce of exceptional power and enlightenment in the Path of Metamorphosis. He was one of the main leaders of the Tzimisce branch of the Anarch Revolt and the Sabbat's mightiest koldun. Elaine Cassidy is a 6th generation ancillia wight, the twisted childe "bride" of Velya that is fused with her sire.

The Blood Burner is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III Zombies and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Endgame. In both appearances, it is a supernatural motorcycle with impressive offensive capability.

Vasantasena (vuh-SAN-tuh-SAY-na or vuh-SUN-tuh-SAY-na; lit. 'Spring's Splendor' in Sanskrit) is a sixth-generation Malkavian elder who foresaw the return of the Antediluvians. When the elders ignored her warnings and the Camarilla sought to subjugate their childer at the Convention of Thorns, Vasantasena abandoned her sire and the Ivory Tower, freeing scores of captured anarchs and becoming a founder of the Sabbat. This makes her one of the first Malkavian antitribu.

Viktor was a 6th generation Gangrel, and one of the generals of Baba Yaga, head of the Army of the Night, the vampires that served the Hag in her attempt to reclaim control over Russia. Viktor was a tall, dark man in perfect shape. His glare was intense and commanding.

Vik Stryker was a Silent Strider, and the leader of the Eagle's Nest Pack. Born in the early 20th century, Vik Stryker and his pack made their names as adventurers in the 1920s and 30s, battling Setite cultists in the Middle East, the Black Steel Centipede Triad in China, and the Ku Klux Klan in the U.S. They garnered even greater fame for their rediscovery of the Lost Caern of Skull Island, their exploration of the Hollow Earth, and the recovery of the Malachite Scarab. He lost his wife, Samantha, in the 1940s, which is the same time that the Eagle's Nest Pack fell apart. In the 1960s, disillusioned, afflicted by Harano and falling into heroin addiction in North Africa after being imprisoned for contempt for refusing to testify before the , he lost the wolf. Stryker lost nearly two decades of his life as a derelict in New York City, living off of the charity of the Bone Gnawers, until an opportunity taken to stop a mugging broke his Harano and restored his will to carry on. He spent his 80s as a private investigator in New York before retiring to Pleasant Port, Maine in the 1990s, where he spent his time assisting the local sheriff and serving as a mentor to several young Garou who had sought him out. In 2002, at the age of 100, Stryker joined a Garou war party plotting against a Setite cult operating out of Portland. Humored by his skeptical allies, his advice actually proved crucial in planning the attack against the cult. As the battle raged, Vik found the will to fight a

The Body Shield is a gameplay mechanic featured in the Campaign and Multiplayer modes of Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, and in Warzone. The Body Shield allows the player to grab an enemy player for a set amount of time and use them as a personal shield, taking bullets for them. The player can also wield their weapon and shoot back at enemy players. The player has the choice of killing the enemy in that shield interaction by either doing a Quick Kill or a Finishing Move. The player can communicate with the grabbed player through Proximity Chat.
Vladimir Sierka is the Russian Confederation's Ministry of the Treasury and a hyperintelligent nova.
Vole is a seventh generation Nosferatu, childe of Rasalon. He is the clan Primogen of Athens.
Vera Vignes is a Vampire Baroness of Los Angeles and wife of the Ventrue Edward Vignes. She blood bound Edward's childe, Henry Waters, to serve herself.

The Blandwell 7x Scope is a sniper scope featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for Assault Rifles and Sniper Rifles.

Verica, known by the locals as the "Ghost of the Stones", is a prominent Nosferatu of Winchester, during the Medieval period. She resides most often at West Kennet, over-looking Silbury Hill, despite the presence of many Lupines in the area.
Victoria Wessler is a medium from Indianapolis, Indiana, who works with the wraith of her dead husband.

For the Setite Methuselah, see Wepwawet.Wepauwet was an ancient Silent Strider during the later days of the war against the Cult of Sutekh in Khem, and a close friend of Shu Horus. When Sutekh cursed the Silent Striders, forced them out of their ancestral home, and cut off their contact with their ancestor spirits, Wepauwet searched for a way to save his people from losing all memory of their heritage. He eventually made a deal with the Undying Horus: in return for mummification as one of the Shemsu-Heru, Wepauwet would serve Horus thereafter. He hoped to become a living library of Silent Strider history. At first, he seemed to have failed. After his First Death, Owl itself spoke to Weapuwet, warning him that the death-and-resurrection of the Undying violated Gaia's intentions for the Garou. Wepauwet would return to life but once -- if he died again, he would fall be trapped in the Underworld as a wraith forever. But recognizing his dedication, Owl led him to the lost Silent Strider Tribal Homeland in the Umbra. There, he alone can see and hear both the ancestor spirits and living Striders who reach the Homeland. In 1978, after millennia of effort, Wepauwet finally created a ritual that could grant a Silent Strider cub what other tribes take for granted: a connection to one of her ancestors. The ritual nearly kills him to use, but he has successfully cast it several times. He was rank 4 in Umbra: The Velvet Shadow and rank 5 in Umbra, Revised Ed.
The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It was added on February 20th, 2025 as part of the Season Two Reloaded update.

Wauneka is a Nosferatu of the 9th Generation in Chicago. Wauneka’s network of spies and informants grows exponentially. The young Nosferatu doesn’t want to become spymaster for the city, desiring no conflict with Bronwyn. However, he is planning to use the information he procures to blackmail what he calls the city’s “failed Cams,” such as Ballard, Newberry, and Neally.

War-Spirits are spirits of conflict typically taking the form of metal, stone, or blood figures, wielding anachronistic weapons and utilizing similarly displaced styles of battle. As with all spirits, these beings revel in the spread of their influence and, as such, are followed by bloody battle. These spirits were known to have appeared during the Neolithic, among the Vinča people — specifically, surrounding an artifact dropped into the Fallen World by the General.

depicting White Father.]] White Father is a highly respected Garou war leader of the Ghost Raptors in the Amazon. He is often possessed by the spirit of Panthesilea. However, he has been exposed to too much toxic waste and radiation. He will soon die and must be replaced. The most prominent contenders to replace him are Orson Bladewalker (Shadow Lord Ragabash), Uthor Bitesilver (Silver Fang Ahroun) and Dione Shadowbreeze (Black Fury Theurge).
Big Metal is the seventh level of the British Campaign in Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS). The player controls a tank in this level.
Wesley Cote is a serial killer who has come unstuck in time.

Will Foster, the Burning Captain, is a wraith responsible for approximately a half-dozen arson attacks that have occurred across the U.S. Gulf Coast in recent years. For years, various communities along the southern coast have suffered what seem to be vicious arson attacks with no culprit to be found. What makes this series of crimes unusual is that most targets have been vehicles — and a few vessels — in motion.
William Ethrac is a Nordic sorcerer and member of the Hagalaz within the Cult of Ecstasy.

Beretta can refer to: *Beretta M1938A - A submachine gun in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One and Call of Duty: WWII. *Beretta M9 - A semi-automatic handgun in the modern era games. *Beretta M93 Raffica - A burst-fire machine pistol in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty Online. *Beretta 23R - A burst-fire handgun in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Strike Team.
Willstrad is a Metis Ahroun Black Spiral Dancer from New York.

Wu Liang was a Wuchang Gui active during the Three Kingdoms period of China. He worked alongside Chen Fung, Daoshi Jun, and Shing. He utilized throwing knives and used walking meditation as a means of calming himself before jobs.
Zaltu, the Visage of the Beast is one of the Apocalyptic Forms available to the Fallen, specifically those of the House of Rabisu.

Corporal Blumel is a character featured in Call of Duty: WWII. He is seen raiding the German base. A German soldier has him at gunpoint when his weapon malfunctions. If the player successfully saves him, it will count as a Heroic Action.
A Broken Soul (First Tongue: Zi'ir) is a werewolf who has degenerated entirely into a thoughtless, amoral monster.
Zubor was a respected and powerful member of the Obertus Tzimisce of Constantinople.
Zdravka was a powerful 5th generation Tzimisce, childe of the Dracon, and sire to the infamous heretic, Nikita of Sredetz.

The , commonly known as the Bren gun, is a British light machine gun featured in Call of Duty, Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty: Finest Hour, Call of Duty 2, Call of Duty 3, Call of Duty: Roads to Victory, Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Vanguard.
Xiao Mengli is an Awakened member of the Akashic Brotherhood.
Yordana, the Voice of Winter, is an Unseelie Satyr Grump and a seer of renown in the Kingdom of Apples.
Yfen is a powerful spirit in service of the Caern of Tarker's Mill. As a servant of the Wyld, Yfen serves as a forest guardian and assists Cahal Filin in his quest against Endron.

"]] The (also known as M2HB) is an American, mounted heavy machine gun that appears in Call of Duty: Finest Hour, Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty 2: Big Red One, Call of Duty 3, Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: World at War, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized, Call of Duty: Black Ops, Find Makarov: Operation Kingfish, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Vanguard, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
Your Pal Charles is a Storm Lord Cahalith member of the Swaggering Rousers of Butcherblock Avenue pack.

Xenon was an Obrimos Sorcerer active in the 4th century BCE. He traveled alongside an expedition he had put together behind Alexander the Great's army. This expedition came into contact with a group of Naga protecting a ruin and the artifacts within; this group killed all but Xenon himself, who managed to escape. Xenon claimed that he had lived with the Naga for some time before they attacked him for picking up a book, and that they would be willing to take him in again. This was false; he had encountered them, but only from a distance. Xenon was merely attempting to gather enough people to safely loot the place.
Yorska is Tzimisce of 6th generation in Vienna, who possessed the body of the Malkavian Misha by the power of his Dominate for revenge against Tremere.
The Browning M1919 (also known as the .30 Cal) is an American machine gun present in most Call of Duty installments set in World War II, as well as in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized.
Zimbra is an Nephwrack and acts as the spectral guardian of the Midnight Circus's Ferris Wheel. He is part of the Third Circle.

Zinnridi was a powerful Carthaginian Lasombra elder and an accomplished warrior. When the Lasombra elders decided to take Iberia from the Brujah and rebellious Lasombra, to establish their own domain to rule the mortals openly, he was in charge of the Clan's forces. He and his warriors caused the Brujah and rebels heavy casualties, but was ultimately defeated by the Brujah leader Yzebel and destroyed. His childer would eventually join the Roman Ventrue and the Eternal Senate against Carthage.

Zayne Morales is a Brujah vampire and a Ministry Dignitary in Indianapolis. He performs double duty as diplomat and monitor of foreign vampire activity. Though the city has relaxed laws surrounding the comings and goings of outsiders, he uses his status as a convert Brujah to keep a foot in each camp, shaking hands with visitors as he takes a read on their purpose in the domain.

Breakdown is a campaign mission and an Eastern Front level in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. When the engine of the tank that Nikolai Badanov and his men were riding on just broke down, they must move their tank to a safe place where they can make repairs before the German infantry arrives. However if they don't hold the Germans back until the tank is repaired, they won't be able to escape in time.
Zachary Forge is a tenth generation Ventrue in the Chicago area. He is a reclusive Golconda seeker on the verge of becoming a Wight.
Yalonda is a ninth generation Ravnos antitribu and Sabbat member in Mexico. After long watching her, she Embraced the vengeful Anka and unleashed her upon the night.

Yaroslav is a Tzimisce of the Medieval period and a prisoner within the Tremere stronghold of Ceoris. He was interrogated by the Tremere Celestyn regarding his clan's ways, especially about the Trial by War and the primitive Tzimisce of Lithuania. He is the blood mate of Devana and participated with her in blood-blending rituals common among their clan. They despise the Tremere and their courtship rendered them immune to Celestyn's attempted blood oath.
The Breda M1930 was the standard light machine gun used by the Royal Italian Army during World War II. It appears in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One and Call of Duty: WWII.
Xiao "Molly" Mao Li is a Thrashing Dragon Thousand-Faced Thunder jina.
Zygaena (齐盖娜) is a Same-Bito Hengeyokai. Same-Bito typically take the form of sharks; in Zygaena's case, a hammerhead shark.
Iosif Czenczick is a wraith of the Hierarchy at the Hanging Gardens.
Bugs is the callsign of an M1128 Mobile Gun System assault vehicle, under the command of General Shepherd working with the U.S. Rangers during the events of Modern Warfare 2.

Nemrods Are a rare type of vampire found within Vampyr. Unlike the other types of vampires, Nemrods are self-loathing vampires that hunt and kill other vampires. Not much is known about these creatures, but legend has it that they can move about undetected by mortals and immortals alike.

is a cartoon character from the Looney Tunes cartoons, who spends most shorts risking his life trying to catch the Road Runner, mostly failing to do so. He and the Road Runner appear at the end of Who Framed Roger Rabbit with a host of other Looney Tunes and non-Warner Bros. cartoon stars.
AMZ-82 Primary Delivery Unit is an aerial unit encountered by Alliance and Horde champions on Mechagon Island.
The is a military transport aircraft featured and mentioned in various Call of Duty games.

A Dwarven Corpse, the corpse of Mori Hildelve, can be found just east of the road to South Gate Pass, at the far eastern end of Dun Morogh. He was an Ironforge Siege Brigade pilot. Pilot Hammerfoot described him as being "tough as nails" and "a good friend."

Abominations are twisted, mutilated undead creatures composed of multiple dead limbs and body parts from many different corpses. They are enormous warriors, scarred by loose stitchings and putrid, open sores. They love to carve flesh and tear their enemies apart. The slow-moving and dull-witted abominations constantly drip blood and smell like disease-ridden slaughterhouses. They carry large cleavers into combat and wield various sickle-bladed hooks on their disproportionate limbs. Almost all abominations lack any real intelligence, having an I.Q. closest to that of an ogre on average. Abominations outwardly appear strangely joyful due to their absent-minded expressions and mannerisms, though this is most likely due to their low level of mental capacity. Like their undead cousins, abominations lust for flesh and are known to eat not only the living but the dead as well. On Azeroth, the abominations were created by Kel'Thuzad, and as such are mainly found in the Scourge's and Forsaken ranks. While for the Forsaken the abominations are primarily kept as guards, some have become highly regarded Forsaken representatives in the military such as Lieutenant Murp of Alterac Valley, which later moved to Wintergrasp. Some of the places where abominations are known to have been built are Undercity, the Fleshwerks and the Plagueworks. Although abominations were once guards in Undercity, they have been replaced with the Kor'kron Guard after the Battle for the Undercity, before making thei

Abrakkar the Wretched is an orc lich of the Scourge. He is also a sorcerer and necromancer. This skeletal being has bluish-white skin stretched tightly over a bony frame. Heavy clothing embroidered with arcane markings drapes over its slight frame. Its eye sockets glow red with malevolence. He speaks Common and Orcish.

Bottom Feeder was a callsign of the M113 APC that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops during the campaign mission The Defector. This vehicle is a homage to Australian involvement in the Vietnam War as it has a Boxing Kangaroo (a native Australian symbol and animal) painted on the side of it.
Adolescent Flame Hounds are hell hounds found in Ragefire Chasm.

Aertin Brighthand served as the Spearhead of the Council of Tirisfal (a prototype of the Guardian of Tirisfal) during the battle with Kathra'natir at Dalaran. He also used to serve as a magi in the court of the father of Prince Nallorath. Unfortunately, when ever a member of the Council of Trisfal fell in battle, the rest of the council was weakened and left vulnerable. Kathra'Natir took advantage of this by knocking a distracted Meryl Winterstorm unconscious and defeating the Council of Tirisfal. Aertin sacrificed the last remains of his power to absorb most of the impact of Kathra'natir's assault in order to protect the Council and fuel Alodi's shield spell, who stepped in to fend off the demon, killing himself.
__NOTOC__ Aetharon is an elemental ascendant located at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands. Using the Air Portal Controller shrinks him, becoming Debilitated Aetharon.
The Brick Blaster is a cut weapon featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare hidden in the game's code. It can only be obtained by using console commands.
__NOTOC__ Aetha is an air spirit located in Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Advisor Melandrus, First Blade of Grand Magistrix Elisande, is a high-ranking nightborne and the final boss of the Court of Stars. He was the one responsible for betraying First Arcanist Thalyssra when she attempted to prevent Elisande from allying with Burning Legion, leading to Thalyssra's exile and transformation into a nightfallen.
Aggem Thorncurse was a named quilboar found in Razorfen Kraul. He has the ability to summon a Boar Spirit, use Battle Shout, and cast Chain Heal.
Breath is a Weapon Proficiency available only for Assault Rifles in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
Agnetta Tyrsdottar is a Hyldnir attempting to use Zeev Fizzlespark as warm-up for the Hyldsmeet. In the process of saving of Zeev, she killed in battle on orders of Lok'lira the Crone.

Ahri'ok Dugru is an orc found in Iron Docks as a part of the Grimrail Enforcers along with Neesa Nox and Makogg Emberblade. She is a shaman who is versed in dark blood magic and an elite mercenary in the employ of the Blackfuse Company.

Agna the Fowl is a Crawliac harpy found atop Windripper Peak in Highmountain and attempting to claim the Skyhorn while the World Quest Retake the Skyhorn is available. She has a roc companion named Skawn.
The was an American military transport aircraft used extensively by the Allies during World War II.

Al'arr Darkhills is a female orc warlock. Al'arr was a child when her father, Shan'ku, joined with the Shadow Council to open the portal to Azeroth. She spied on her father and his comrades and studied magic without his knowledge. When the First War ended, she strode into the Shadow Council’s secret meeting, shocking them all with her prowess. She helped keep the council together after the Second War, and then helped form the Burning Blade. Her skill is such that she is Klass Metalfist's first choice for the leader of the Shadowbreak Ravine chapter, as they are the foremost demon-summoning group. She is uglier than normal orc woman, female orc fangs usually stop at four inches, hers have grown much longer due to corruption.

Akali was a Drakkari rhino loa. He was held in chains by his worshipers outside the gates of Gundrak. At Har'koa's behest, adventurers were sent to free Akali who quickly killed his subduers. However, the Prophet of Akali noticed and killed Akali in order to drink the loa's blood, claiming some of his power.

Alaric was once Thule Ravenclaw's head servant and bodyguard. Thule used his magic to "protect" him from the Plague of Undeath giving him an undead form. Later Thule gave his head to the Rot Hide gnolls as a plaything. The rest of his body was buried in an unnamed Shallow Grave. After finding him, an adventurer put Alaric's Remains in a niche of a Dusty Shelf to hide him from the gnolls.

The is a wheeled armoured troop carrier which doubles as an infantry fighting vehicle. Designed to be mine-resistant, they carry a squad of soldiers each. Numerous South African army Buffels appear in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, manned by Jonas Savimbi and his UNITA troops. Alex Mason briefly attempts to rescue a dying militiaman from one after a mortar barrage.

Akaridal is a saurok dinomancer of the Skumblade tribe who appears at the Golakka Hot Springs in Un'Goro Crater during the Un'Goro Madness micro-holiday. As a dinomancer, he can call upon the aid of various primal creatures: triceratops, pterodactyls and worms.
Akiormi is a bronze drakonid located in the Primalist Future.
Alexandra Constantine is a human gryphon flight master found in Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. It's unknown if she survived the Ironmarch.

Buster is the callsign of an ASD of the Colossus security staff appearing in Karma where it can be activated from its station before the player opens the mall doors by players using the Access Kit. The player then asks Farid to hack an ASD at remote station 55. There is a career record challenge for protecting Buster until the end of the mission. ru:Бастер

__NOTOC__ The ghost of Allendril Fallcreek wanders the Ruins of Eldre'thar in Stonetalon Mountains. He and the other ghosts are reliving their past lives. He seems to relive Illyanna Stonewood's rejection of his proposals.

The elusive Elven Ranger known as Alleria learned of the devastation the Horde could bring as she searched for the remains of her family amongst the ashes of the once glorious Quel'thalas. Her all-consuming hatred for the Orcs led her to Azeroth where she leads an elite cadre of Rangers to hunt down the remaining Orc renegades of the Bleeding Hollow clan.
All-Seer Xanarian is an inquisitor located at the Terminus in the Antoran Wastes. He has a Debilitating Eye guarding him and providing stealth detection.
The is a large military transport aircraft that appears in Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
Algenon is an unbound water elemental located in Island Expeditions.

__NOTOC__ Alithea is a kyrian spirit healer located outside Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains during the Kyrian Campaign. She also appears in the Font of Fealty in the Seat of the Archon during The Grand Reception (quest).
Algel the Haunter is a wraith located in the Maw as a boss of a Tormentors of Torghast event.
Burst Fire is an attachment featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Vanguard, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, and a weapon perk in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.

Archbishop Alonsus Faol is the leader of the Conclave, an order uniting all the priesthoods of Azeroth. In life, he was the Archbishop of the Church of the Holy Light and the mentor of many heroes of the Alliance of Lordaeron, including the first paladin of Azeroth, Uther the Lightbringer. In the beginning of the Second War, Alonsus learned of the massacre that the Holy Order of Northshire Clerics had suffered against the orcs during the First War. In order to lend the Church's support, he created with Anduin Lothar an order of holy warriors, the Order of the Knights of the Silver Hand. With the help of Uther, he recruited and trained Turalyon, Tirion Fordring, Saidan Dathrohan, and Gavinrad to make them the first paladins of Azeroth. After completing their training, he chose his apprentice to be the first paladin and their leader in the fight against the Old Horde. During the war, Alonsus joined the Council of Seven Nations and ensured that the meetings between the kings of the Seven Kingdoms did not turn into conflicts. After their victory over the orcs, he worked for years to restore the Kingdom of Stormwind and the lands of Lordaeron, ordering his priests and paladins to help those in need. Among his projects, he invested funds in the reconstruction of Stormwind City, reformed the Brotherhood of Northshire and the Northshire Abbey, and oversaw the reconstruction of the Cathedral of Light. At some point, Alonsus died for unknown reasons and was succeeded by his apprentice
__NOTOC__ Alluvion is a water elemental located in Blackwind Lake in Terokkar Forest, accessible only by flying. He can usually be found wandering along the big lake in the middle of the area.
__NOTOC__ Altar Wardens are air revenants located at the Altar of Quetz'lun in Zul'Drak.

The Bombsight is a weapon seen in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One. It is exclusive to the level "Liberators". After "Stretch" Roger eliminates many Luftwaffe planes, the player is tasked by the pilot to bomb two German tanker ships. The player can only drop the bombs if the Liberator is level. After the player successfully destroys the two ships, the player continues destroying more planes. It is later used again to destroy several fuel tanks.

Alzzin the Wildshaper is a satyr found in Dire Maul East. He is the final boss of the wing. Old Ironbark opens the door to access Alzzin. The Felvine Shard is located behind him. You do not require to have the quest Shards of the Felvine before you pick up Felvine Shard.

Altruis the Sufferer is a renegade night elf demon hunter originally brought to Outland by Illidan Stormrage. He ultimately left the Betrayer's service when he decided that Illidan had become the very thing he was sworn to fight, making camp in western Nagrand with his nether drake mount, Nethrandamus, and making plans against the Burning Legion encampments there. Akama admired Altruis for opposing the direction Illidan was taking. He was eventually captured by the night elf Wardens, who imprisoned him along with the other demon hunters in the Vault of the Wardens. Freed during the third invasion of the Burning Legion and although reconciled with his Illidari brethren, Altruis still does not condone Illidan's methods and wants new leadership for the Illidari. Altruis is one of two characters player demon hunters can choose to be their second-in-command, the other being Kayn Sunfury, whose ideals and plans for the Illidari are incompatible with Altruis' own.

Amani Berserkers are forest trolls found in the troll camps Zeb'Watha and Tor'Watha which are located around Lake Elrendar in Eversong Woods. They, along with the other trolls who inhabit the Eversong Woods/Ghostlands area are bitter foes of the blood elves.
The are a melee weapon in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. They are also briefly seen in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Mobile.

__NOTOC__ Alynblaze is a ghost of a night elf paladin, located in the Crumbled Palace in Azsuna. He is a trusted companion of Enchantress Ilanya. Upon receiving enchantments from the class order leader, the ghost assisted them in slaying Fathom-Commander Eksis.

Amahle Flintwill was a son of Captain Marjani Flintwill raised aboard the Makemba of the Blackwater Raiders to the life of a pirate along with his other siblings who had different fathers. He was only two years older than Makasa with whom he often fought, tickling her until she no longer was ticklish. Makasa believed that the other two brothers never forgave Amahle for that. From the three brothers, he was the strong one. Around the Year 28, he joined the Sea King as its third mate. After several weeks of its first voyage, the Sea King crew plundered the merchant ship Winter's Knot. When the crew were enjoying its spoils and were a bit light-headed, the Sea King was attacked by two Bloodsail ships, the Orca and the Killmonger. Most of the crew was killed while the others were captured, the Flintwill siblings being among the latter group. One of the Bloodsail captains, Ironpatch, executed Adashe. Upon seeing this, the chained Akashinga and Amahle charged at the orc pirate, knocking and chocking him. The Killmongers crew pulled the brothers off their captain and within minutes, Ironpatch killed the Flintwill brothers. During this, the Wavestrider crew sneaked into the Killmonger and then to the Sea King, and defeated the Bloodsail pirates, with Makasa personally killing Captain Ironpatch, avenging the deaths of her brothers. After this, the bodies of the Flintwill brothers and the deceased Sea King crewmen were buried at the sea.
Alyndriel Graveborn is a banshee located at the Ruby Dragonshrine in The Deaths of Chromie scenario.

Boosts are a feature in Call of Duty: Heroes. Boosts allow the player to increase the production rate of a certain resource or to train troops faster. There are several types of boosts: *Gold Boost *Oil Boost *Diamond Boost *Unit Boost *Machine Boost *Atlas Boost Boosts for the Gold Miner, Oil Pumps, and Training Compound are unlocked once the structure is upgraded to level 4; all others have it unlocked by default. These boosts vary in length, ranging from a couple of hours to a week. The basic length for each of the boosts for Celerium changes for purpose. Resource boosts (Gold, Oil, and Diamond) last twenty-four hours, while troop boosts (Unit, Machine, Atlas) last only two hours. However, the former only doubles the production rate, whereas the latter quadruples it. Boosts of various time lengths can be received in Supply Drops from the Landing Zone. These can be shorter or longer than usual, depending on the rarity of the looted boost.
Althanus is a blue dragonspawn located in Camp Antonidas in the Azure Span.
Ameri Windblade is a blood elf flight master found at the Shattered Landing in Blasted Lands.
Ambassador Pax'ivi is an ethereal trapped within the Mana-Tombs Stasis Chamber in the Mana-Tombs. Freeing him is the objective of Stasis Chambers of the Mana-Tombs.

The Bootlegger (referred to as the Sten in the game files) is a Submachine Gun appearing in Call of Duty: Black Ops III exclusively in the Zombies mode. It appears in Shadows of Evil, and the remastered versions of Nacht der Untoten, Verrückt, and Shi No Numa.

of the Hand of Argus in the Exodar.]] Anchorite is an honorific title the draenei use for their priests, and perhaps not a true synonym, as it is also a rank within the draenei priesthood. The higher rank corresponding to Grand Anchorite. They take care of the sick and wounded, while seniors are responsible for training aspiring anchorites. Dedicated to the cause of the Light and their priesthood, they organize ceremonies and sermons, teaching the ways of the Light while sharing their knowledge and wisdom with those who need help. Some of them decide to travel in order to spread their faith, to teach to the races of the Alliance and learn from them, but also to give their aid and fight the evil through Azeroth and Outland. Others may join the ranks of the Alliance armies, where they protect and heal their comrades on the battlefields.
Anchorite Taliah is a draenei anchorite located on the Sword of Dawn prior to the battle for the Broken Shore. She participated in training novice adventurers by healing them after their duels.
Ancient Flamewraiths are spectres located in Temple of a Thousand Lights in Azsuna.
The Butterfly Knife is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Mobile, and a weapon blueprint in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.

Ancient Draenei Spirits are draenei ghosts located in Terokkar Forest. Many are found near Levixus at Auchindoun. A few are found with Ramdor the Mad at the entrance to the Auchenai Crypts. They are only visible after Vision of the Dead has been completed.

Ancients of wonders act as magic storehouses for night elf culture. They spend much of their time crafting magic items, and store the items they create in their branches and in nooks in their bark. They also train night elf spellcasters in the ways of magic item creation and forms of natural alchemy. Ancients of wonders leave melee combat to other ancients and to their night elven allies. In battle, they use magic items - usually wands or staffs - to blast their enemies with druidic spells.

Commander Andarin Lightblade is mysterious swordsman in Mount Hyjal. He is strange for an Argent Dawn Templar. He was apparently once a paladin, and perhaps still is, he wears no armor other than an ornate breastplate, which may be just for show. Andarin is a solid fighter and a good representative of member of the Argent Dawn. Once, Lightblade, wielding a bastard sword, was fighting a losing battle against a black dragon. He decided to make a final gamble to try to destroy the beast. He cast his famous spell, "Lightblade's Final Strike", sacrificing much of his life (enough to make him unconscious but not kill him outright). The attack dealt much damage to the dragon. Back when he was a paladin, Andarin invaded Undercity with fifty men to launch a surprise attack on Varimathras while the Banshee Queen was away in Northrend. Later, he went to Undercity again; this time to set some prisoners free. While preparing to assault an abomination, he was discovered by a Forsaken, Trevor. The undead, who was once a priest of the Holy Light, proposed him a deal: Trevor would not alarm the guards if Andarin would speak on Trevor's behalf asking the Argent Dawn to accept him as a priest in their ranks. The deal was made, and while the paladin kept the guards at bay, the undead freed two prisoners, a mage and a young girl that Trevor knew well.

The Buzz Cut is a melee weapon in Call of Duty: Black Ops III that was added in the June 14, 2016 update. It is obtained through Supply Drops. It appears to be an axe made from scratch, given its haphazard and shoddy look. Its main components make it seem as it could have come out of a garage: a saw blade as the axe's head, a wood shaft or handle, a bracket attaching the saw to the handle, and possibly a stronger form of duct or electrical tape holding the saw in place. It can be acquired in Revelations by completing 15 rounds in under 24 minutes.
__NOTOC__ The Ancient Storms Wyrm is found behind a wall of trees after the Human base in The Druids Arise. It drops a Sobi Mask upon death.
Andellis is a night elf ghost located in Nar'thalas Academy in Azsuna.
The Ancient Timekeeper is a sand elemental located at the Sand-Lost Sanctum in Thaldraszus.
The Bow is a weapon featured in Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

Angelique Butler is a human first aid supplier located in the Magus Commerce Exchange in Dalaran. When Dalaran relocated above Deadwind Pass and the Burning Legion attacked the city, she was seen healing Dalaran Citizens.

Anenga is the Alliance druid leader in Stormshield Outpost, Ashran. With the aid of adventurers, he works to empower the Lifeless Protector, transforming it into the Draenor ancient Fangraal, who will do battle for the Alliance.

Angus Ironfist is a dwarf monk first appearing in the Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit. He and Hiro are good friends. He joined the Order of the Broken Temple and was sent on a mission to Stormheim. At Felskorn Warcamp, he asked the Grandmaster for help to free Tortured Prisoners, Sylara Steelsong, and Hiro that had been captured by the Burning Legion at the Gates of Valor as well as to steal Storm Brew. After freeing his monk friends, Angus returned to the Temple of Five Dawns and pledged himself to Grandmaster as their champion.

Break Point is an Epic gun perk featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. This gun perk is, as of now, only available on the epic variant of the R3K assault rifle, the R3KT. It takes the normally 3-round burst assault rifle and gives it full auto capabilities, as well as having reduced recoil. The gun attains a fire rate similar to the Volk assault rifle. The gun is still a 3-shot kill in Core modes.
Ango'rosh Warlocks are ogre magi located in Zangarmarsh. They summon imps.

Angellene is a banshee located in the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest during the Forsaken heritage questline. She's accompanied by Margix, Emalora, and Aelthalyste. She can be chosen to accompany the adventurer into Valgan's Field.

Anji the Thundering is a Zandalari troll druid in a beast form located in the Zocalo in Dazar'alor. They are accompanied by Slumbering Druids and sometimes joined by Wild Kranzae. Approaching them provides the following buff: *
The Bushwhacker is a melee weapon in Call of Duty: Black Ops III that was added in the October 17, 2016‎ update.

Anveena Teague appeared to be a kind and beautiful human peasant girl from Tarren Mill. Unbeknown to anyone, she was in fact not a human at all, but rather the remaining energies of the Sunwell transfigured into the form of a human avatar by the red dragon Korialstrasz.

Anya Eversong is a dark ranger in the Forsaken forces. She is an unsettling undead figure wearing a long, shadowladen cloak, obscuring most of her features and causing her to fade into the darkness. She holds a dark, glowing bow of elven make. Anya is first and foremost a ranged fighter. Her magical quiver contains arrows of all types and makes, variable enough for any encounter. She prefers to snipe from the cover of shadows, where her cloak and shadowmeld abilities make her invisible. She is perfectly capable of firing arrows while on the move, or even in melee. She targets spellcasters with silence spells to prevent them from casting, and weak-willed targets with charm person. She casts black arrow on her bow when strong foes surround her, or when she needs the extra skeletons her arrows create. If she is low on life, she casts drain life on slow targets, siphoning their life and recovering from her wounds.

Aponi Brightmane is a tauren paladin and the founder and leader of the Sunwalkers. In Legion, she joined the player as a follower of the Knights of the Silver Hand in its final stand against the Burning Legion. In Cataclysm, tauren became an eligible race for the paladin class. Brightmane was introduced as the leader of the Sunwalkers after (re)discovering the powers of An'she. In World of Warcraft, she was found on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.
The C12 is a bipedal 12-foot drone tank featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It can operate in autonomous or semi-autonomous modes.

Aodhan Falamar is a young human mage and a student under Master Simeon. At the start of the Nexus War, Dalaran was attacked by blue dragons and Aodhan was tricked into freeing his uncle from the Violet Hold. Luckily he, alongside Archmage Rhonin and Master Simeon managed to stop Crevan from making Dalaran fall from the sky.

Ar'kelos is an arcane guardian found guarding the entrance of the Violet Tower in the Netherstorm. Ar'kelos seems to be giving off a dampening field that prevents from using his magic, which is why Vargoth can't simply just kill the golem himself.

__NOTOC__ Aquantion is a water elemental who was summoned and enslaved as a symbol of the dominion over water by the citizens of Suncrown Village. However, he somehow had a murloc aid him, and sabotaged the ritual which enabled him to break free, and consequently attack the villagers. Geranis Whitemorn, a citizen of Suncrown Village who died in Aquantion's attack, returned to life as a ghost, rather than a wraith. He has members of the Horde who are willing to listen to him to complete the ritual and destroy Aquantion. It has a high frost resistance.

The Brawler's Brew (or Bottle in development) is an Epic melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered that was added in the December 13, 2016‎ update. It is only available through opening supply drops in the Depot or through purchase using 3,600 Parts. The Brawler's Brew is functionally identical to the Knife. However, unlike the Knife, the Brawler's Brew can be equipped in a matter similar to that of the Combat Knife featured in previous installments. The Brawler's Brew resembles that of a broken liquor bottle commonly used in bar fights. It is a part of the Gunslinger collection.
Aqueous Lords are water elementals found in the Karabor Sewers in the Black Temple. They see through stealth.
__NOTOC__ Aquelian Honor Guards are water elementals located at Foulshore Strip on the Broken Shore. They accompany Champion Aquaclease. They also appear in Nazjatar.
Aquious the Tidebreaker is a water elemental that was disturbed by the Hatecoil naga so he had to be put down by the mages of the Tirisgarde.

Burst Rush is an Operator Mod exclusive to the Tigershark light machine gun in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. The Operator Mod modifies the Tigershark's firing mode from fully-automatic to a six-round burst conversion along with extending the barrel. When firing, the last four bullets within the burst will be fired within an accelerated rate.

Arandis Sunfire is a blood elf mage who accompanied Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner to Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff to discuss the catastrophe in Silithus. He was here in order to ensure that Sylvanas could leave quickly if she needed to. During the meeting, Magni Bronzebeard arrived to the city but needed a teleport as he was too heavy for the city lifts. Once Magni finished telling about the healing of Azeroth, the Speaker asked to be teleported to Desolace.
Arakkoa Windwalker is an arakkoa located in the Violet Hold replacing Erekem after wipes.

__NOTOC__ Arc-Consul Velara is an eredar located at the Conservatory of the Arcane in Eredath. As one of Archimonde's greatest pupils, Velara held such power in her own disciplines that the Conservatory remembers her even centuries later. She must be defeated in order for the Army of the Light to advance their quest to obtain the Sigil of Awakening.
Burst Snipe is an attachment in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. The attachment is exclusive to the EBR-800 sniper rifle.

Arcanimus is an arcane elemental found in Moonrest Gardens in the Dragonblight. Arcanimus is devouring the souls of the dead Highborne in Moonrest Gardens and for that, Ethenial Moonshadow wants Arcanimus destroyed.
Arcanist Windlebop is a gnome flight master located around the Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.
Arcanist Shal'iman is a spectre located at the Nor'Danil Wellspring in Azsuna.
The is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. It was added as part of the Season Four update.
Arcanist Thinwhisp is a banshee encountered by Class Orders in the Temple of a Thousand Lights in Azsuna.
Archmage Allistarj was a demonic human archmage found in Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands. Although once human, Allistarj was now in fact demonic.
__NOTOC__ Archdruid Thom'acos is a night elf druid located at the Emerald Gardens in the Ohn'ahran Plains. He learned to replicate the power of the twin moons through introspection and perseverance.

The Bullet Return is a Weapon Perk featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, available to all Sniper Rifles, minus the NA-45, and Marksman Rifles. When equipped, the perk grants a chance to regain a single bullet upon a kill with compatible weapon.

Arellas Fireleaf has a large statue erected in his honor in the Hall of Champions, located in the Scarlet Monastery in the Tirisfal Glades. A citizen of Quel'Thalas, Fireleaf became the High Wizard of the Scarlet Crusade. He is said to be locked in eternal combat with the Necromancer Diesalven.

Argaleus was a powerful mage. He created a book containing magically enchanted symbols, which, upon touch would activate powerful spells. It is said that he learned this unique spell language from Malygos, the aspect of magic.
Arenji is a cloud serpent located near Historian Jenji in the Shrine of Seven Stars. The cloud serpent is present in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.

The Bomber Plane is an aerial vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Warzone. It was added as part of the Season Two update of Call of Duty: Vanguard. It is only available in Caldera. It's a variant of the B-25 bomber with a fictional turret setup and four-bladed propellers.
Argi is a companion that resembles a mix between a draenei and a goat. She bears a :Gift of the Naaru upon her forehead.
Argent Bowmen were humans participating in the Dark Portal Opens event. They fire Ice Arrows.

The wildkin Aroom is the last of his tribe in Darkshore and is a powerful elder with a strong connection to Elune. The wildkin were once numerous in Darkshore. Such are their ties to the land that the Cataclysm that shattered Darkshore also decimated their numbers. His help is most necessary for Malfurions healing of the land.

The Branson is a Signature Attachment for the ASM10 assault rifle in Call of Duty: Mobile. It was added in August 2022 as part of the Season 7: New Vision City update. When equipped, the attachment will give the weapon the "hyperburst" mechanism akin to most previous iterations of the AN-94, with the first two rounds of every trigger pull being fired in burst, at a faster rate than the next continuous follow-up shots. It also sports increased recoil control, at the cost of rather hefty mobility reduction.

Arthur the Faithful is a human paladin and paladin trainer located in the Cathedral of Light in the human city of Stormwind. He is one of the more prominent paladins in Stormwind, and serves to train aspiring paladins in their craft. He can be found in the eastern wing of the cathedral, in a room off the main hall, alongside fellow paladin trainers Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker and Katherine the Pure. Following the death of Tirion Fordring during the Battle for Broken Shore, Arthur the Faithful joined the Order of the Silver Hand and moves to the Sanctum of Light to serve the new Highlord of the Silver Hand. He is seen kneeling with the aura of Divine Prayer beside the statue of the deceased Highlord.

Artorius the Doombringer is a doomguard disguised as a tauren named Artorius the Amiable, located in Winterspring. He was one of four vile agents of the Burning Legion which Vartrus the Ancient, a tree spirit from Irontree Woods in Felwood, wishes to see destroyed. Only a skilled hunter was able to find the demons in their disguises and defeat them. Artorius was part of the hunter epic quest to obtain Rhok'delar, Longbow of the Ancient Keepers and Lok'delar, Stave of the Ancient Keepers. As with all of the demons, he must be killed by the hunter alone: no heals, pets, mid-fight buffs, etc. Each demon requires the hunter to find their weakness to a hunter skill. Artorius' specific weakness is to the poison of a hunter's Serpent Sting. When affected by the sting, he gains a debuff called Stinging Trauma, doing massive amounts of damage. The key to this fight is to stay out of range of his demonic magic, which is able to mutate players into a demon, simultaneously dealing large amounts of damage to the hunter.
Arvon the Betrayed is a human ghost located at the Iceveil Glacier in Drustvar.
The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II.
__NOTOC__ Arylina is night elf ghost located at the Highborne Estates in Nazjatar.

Aru is a young centaur hunter of Clan Shikaar encountered throughout the Ohn'ahran Plains. He is locked in a friendly rivalry with Belika over who is the better hunter; Aru believes that precision is more important than speed, while Belika believes the opposite. It's not specified if Aru and Belika are siblings or cousins, but they are both cousins to Initiate Aqira.
Asha was Lokra's frost wolf companion, located in the Stonefang Outpost of Frostfire Ridge. She was killed by the Iron Wolf, but her ghost later returned and guided the Horde adventurer.
Bryson International is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

__NOTOC__ Asher is a fire elemental found at the Altar of Kron in Frostfire Ridge. He succeeded Exurotus as the Fury of Frostfire. He only appears when mages teleport to Frostfire Ridge to get the Everburning Crystal.
Ashbearers are flamewakers found at Flamewake in Mount Hyjal. They appear to attack the flameward during Prepping the Soil.
Ashigos was a blue dragon who was slain by the black dragonflight. His name is on a Fresh Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.

Bruen Arms is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. Their logo is a capital and bold letter B.

__NOTOC__ Aspersius is a water elemental located at the Terrace of Endless Spring, it was corrupted by the Burning Legion when they invaded the area. The corrupted water elemental is fought by a party consisting of the Grand Master, Taran Zhu, Taoshi, Hawkmaster Nurong and Fei Li, who vanquish the hostile elemental and claim Sheilun, Staff of the Mists from its remains.

Battle for Azeroth= |-| Classic= Athrikus Narassin was a Highborne night elf in Darkshore. wanted Athrikus's head. He was slain by Alliance adventurers, but even after his death his tome could be found in the burnt tower. During the Fourth War, he returned as a spectre.
Atal'ai Witch Doctors are elite jungle trolls found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

The Broodmother .45 Kit is a conversion kit for the WSP-9 submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III as part of the Aftermarket Parts system. The Broodmother .45 Kit enhances the damage, range, and recoil control at the cost of overall handling and rate of fire.

Atomik is the Horde shaman leader of Warspear Outpost, Ashran. With the aid of adventurers, he works to empower the Underpowered Earth Fury, transforming it into the Earth Fury Kronus, who will do battle for the Horde.
Atai'natha was a leader of the Amani forest trolls who used a powerful magical claw to enforce his rule. The Lost Codex of the Amani spends a particularly long time describing him.
__NOTOC__ Athiona is a twilight dragon that can be encountered during Island Expeditions.

Built In appears as a series of Common gun perks in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. Built In gives the Prototype Weapon an integrated standard attachment, such in the form of an Optic that is automatically added.

Athanos is a centurion located at the Aspirant's Crucible in Bastion. He has a tendency to humble new aspirants of the Kyrian with overwhelming force. Athanos has previously used a spear called Humility's Guard. Athanos is later turned to the Forsworn. Lysonia attempts to channel Athanos's anima to recharge Truthbringer, but he is defeated by the Maw Walker with the help of Pelagos, Kleia, and Mikanikos, and is left unconscious. Ultimately, he is purified and present at the Font of Fealty in the Seat of the Archon during The Grand Reception (quest). A memory of Athanos was retrieved by the Maw Walker which was used in The Path of Ascension.

The Attendants are a race of mysterious beings who are summoned into existence to maintain the city of Oribos and ensure that the Arbiter carries out her duties without interruption. All of their decisions are guided by "the Purpose", a belief that the Shadowlands follow a pattern laid out by the Arbiter in her infinite wisdom. Each Attendant that serves the Purpose is assigned to one of three paths: *Caretakers maintain the stability and operations of Oribos and tend to the Arbiter's needs, referred to as the Hands of the Arbiter. *Scholars hold the knowledge of the Eternal City. From within this circle, the Honored Voice Tal-Inara was selected to speak on behalf of the ever-silent Arbiter and interpret her will and wisdom, as well as Fatescribe Roh-Tahl who has insight into the threads of fate and is said to have the power to affect the destinies of living mortals. *Protectors serve as a stoic militia who defend Oribos and maintain the order within, referred to as the Shield of the Arbiter. Recently, the Arbiter has gone dormant and is no longer directing souls to their just afterlives. Attendants have sought in vain to unravel this mystery, causing some to question their faith in the Purpose. Korthian attendants led by their Archivist have committed their existence to researching the relics from across the Shadowlands, they are dedicated to recovering the relics scattered across Korthia in the wake of the Mawsworn invasion.

Avatar of Freya, also called "the Lifewarden", was created by Keeper Freya as a failsafe to watch over Sholazar Basin if she couldn't. She remembers all living things that have been under her care. During the war against the Lich King, she stood at the Rainspeaker Rapids, watching over the blighted lands near the fallen Lifeblood Pillar, and protecting the region against the threat of the Scourge. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard asked her how the lands fared and her answer was "better than they were during the war, and healing slowly". When they brought up the subject of their ancestor, Mina Stormsmith, the Avatar of Freya said that she once met her after the dwarf journeyed to Sholazar Basin from Dragonblight. She described her as very young, but with the determination of a warrior, and wielding her brother's axe (which had an emanation of Light and Life). The Lifeward explained that Mina stayed for a bit, asking for stories of the titans and keepers and helping her with her work. She then mentioned that she was "sad" when the dwarf left, frustrated by the lack of answers to her questions about the Forge of Wills, and leaving to resume her journey towards Ulduar.

Burst Fire Alternate Mode is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the "Jaeger" Prototype Weapon version of the Proteus. It changes the fire type of the Shotgun mode of the Proteus to a quick double burst before needing to be pumped.
Auctioneer Expordira is a green dragon auctioneer located in Valdrakken.
Auctioneer Imporigo is a blue dragon auctioneer located in Valdrakken.
